items.title: Show HN: RNKFlow I wanted HN but live like Digg, it became something much bigger (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: HN's content has always been great, but the interface, not so much. I wanted to feel the live movement of Digg, stories reordering in real time based on rank. That quickly escalated, turning into a multi-feed blend from arXiv, Product Hunt, Ars Technica, Bleeping Computer and many more. The Hot tab combines them all based on rank without letting any single feed overpower the rest. No login needed to give it a try. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48382929 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
